descriptions.w3d_f2a_polar_vector_80028f48: Builds a three-float vector using samples from object offsets 96 and 100, cosine and sine of offset 72, and original constants 0x8036cedc and 0x8036cee0. Subtracts the scaled third sample from x and returns the vector by value. Names and field meanings are inferred; referenced external data ownership is not claimed.
